_comment: Checked-in performance baselines for the full-stack E2E replay-reconnect spec (plan §8 test 7). The reconnect-replay budget is computed at runtime as max(REPLAY_BUDGET_FLOOR_MS, p99_warmup_ms * 1.5). Values are measured from a clean local dev box; CI may exceed the floor under cold-cache conditions, hence the 1.5× headroom.
_source: local dev box: M2 Pro, 16 GB RAM, 3-node cluster + websocket-server + Vite dev

replayReconnect._comment: Time from CONNECTED-after-reconnect → all 10 missed orders visible in OrderBlotter, p99 across 20 warmup runs (best-of-3 medians).

commandClientAlloc._comment: Amortized bytes per submitOrder call after warmup (10_000 calls, --js-flags=--expose-gc + COOP/COEP). Pool buffer + slot reuse target: ≤16 B/call.
